text:
alex: Hey team — I captured an nsys trace from the nightly perf job (large model, ~18B). Going to share for regression triage but want to scrub any prod paths/keys first. Who can do a quick sanity scrub + upload? :raising_hand:
maria: I can scrub. Quick Q: do we need to remove absolute file paths or also env vars that might be embedded?
sam: both. nsys sometimes records full paths in the metadata; scrub paths + replace env-like strings. I usually gzip the .qdrep and then run our scrub script.
ajex: (typo) alex: fwiw the raw is ~12GB compressed. upload link will be heavy.
ryan: For large traces please: 1) compress to .tar.gz 2) run scrub (see example below) 3) upload to s3 path with a metadata JSON that lists model, commit, seed, job-id. We have 90d retention by default.
sam: example scrub flow:
```bash
# capture
nsys profile --output=/tmp/run_1903456789.qdrep --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=none 
# compress
gzip -c /tmp/run_1903456789.qdrep > /tmp/run_1903456789.qdrep.gz
# scrub (replace absolute paths, remove env lines)
python devops/perf/scrub_trace.py --input /tmp/run_1903456789.qdrep.gz --output /tmp/run_1903456789.scrub.gz --replace-paths "/home/ubuntu,/mnt/nvme" --redact-env
```
(we have scrub_trace.py in repo; it strips home paths, replaces with <REDACTED_PATH>, and wipes env sections)
jordan: Quick note: if you need to include torchprof info, please attach the .ptprof JSON alongside the qdrep. Combine metadata so reviewers know the token lengths and batch config.
maria: uploading to staging bucket s3://redwood-perf-staging/traces/1903456789/ — will set ACL internal-only. Will add metadata file: metadata-1903456789.json containing: model, branch, commit, sequence_len, batch_size, perf-job-id.
perf-bot: artifact uploaded: <https://storage.redwood.ai/traces/1903456789/run_1903456789.scrub.gz|run_1903456789.scrub.gz> (size: 1.8GB after scrub+compress). Retention: 90d. :white_check_mark:
alex: awesome, thanks. maria can you post the scrub checklist here (so we can reuse for other threads)? :pray:
maria: checklist TL;DR: compress -> scrub paths -> redact env -> strip user ids from nvtx annotations -> add metadata JSON -> upload to s3/internal storage -> ping eng-runtime + perf for triage. I'll paste full checklist as a gist after.
ryan: minor ops ask: mark ticket with `perf:nsys` label and link to artifact. That helps automation pick up and index.
jordan: if reviewers need a flamegraph snapshot, run `nsys-ui --capture` locally to export a flamegraph PNG before scrubbing and attach that too (small).
sam: noted — i'll run a quick sanity flamegraph and attach to the ticket. :eyes:
alex: perfect, leaving triage to y'all. thanks!
